entities.name: Azeworai
entities.description: Author of fables such as The Ugly Bird.

entities.name: Asmira
entities.description: Holy Avenger who seeks to free Mangara.

entities.name: Mangara
entities.description: A figure imprisoned in amber by Kaervek, freed at the price of Asmira's life.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker and speaker on time.

entities.name: Kaervek
entities.description: Villain who imprisoned Mangara and taints Jamuraa.

entities.name: Purraj of Urborg
entities.description: Figure who sang slaughter and danced death.

entities.name: Jolrael
entities.description: Woman who will betray Kaervek or Jamuraa.

entities.name: Kasib ibn Naji
entities.description: Letter writer who saw a Phyrexian walker.

entities.name: Suleiman
entities.description: A ruler whose ascent humbled djinn and efreets of ancient Rabiah.

entities.name: Aku
entities.description: City of hidden graves and lost kings.

entities.name: Tefemburu
entities.description: Skies over which Ruya will pin fliers.

entities.name: Rabiah
entities.description: Ancient land of djinn and efreets.

events.summary: Sisay recalls angels sing their swords' names with each strike.
events.quote: "My mother once told me angels sing their swords' names with each strike."

events.summary: Telim'Tor calls surviving the war the true dishonor.
events.quote: "The true dishonor for a soldier is surviving the war."

events.summary: Ruya vows to pin winged creatures to the skies over Tefemburu.
events.quote: "If it bears wings, I will pin it to the skies over Tefemburu."

events.summary: Asmira's prayers should have freed Mangara from the amber prison.
events.quote: Asmira's prayers alone should have freed Mangara from the amber prison . . .

events.summary: The price of Mangara's freedom was Asmira's life.
events.quote: but the price of Mangara's freedom was Asmira's life.

events.summary: Asmira warns the meek shall wound those who tread on them.
events.quote: "Tread upon the meek, and they shall wound your feet and make you crawl."

events.summary: Asmira, Rashida and Jabari chant to be bound together.
events.quote: "We are to be bound together as the reeds of a basket."

events.summary: Kaervek imprisoned Mangara out of jealousy and taints Jamuraa out of spite.
events.quote: "Kaervek imprisoned Mangara out of jealousy, but he taints Jamuraa simply out of spite."

events.summary: Mangara confronts Kaervek's arrogance.
events.quote: "Your arrogance amazes me, Kaervek. Did you not know the price you would pay?"

events.summary: Teferi predicts Kaervek's coming demise.
events.quote: in truth, they mourn aloud for his impending demise."

events.summary: Kaervek says killing the land destroys the future.
events.quote: "Kill a creature, destroy the present. Kill the land, destroy the future."

events.summary: Kaervek says he would rule the dead.
events.quote: What do I care if I rule over the dead rather than over the living?

events.summary: Shauku tells a victim she offered eternal life but not where.
events.quote: "I offered you eternal life; I just didn't say *where*."

events.summary: Jolrael foresees betrayal of Kaervek or Jamuraa.
events.quote: "I have seen the horrors Kaervek has freed. My betrayal is certain—but of Kaervek or of Jamuraa, I cannot say."

events.summary: Zarkuu jokes about being dead for a few minutes.
events.quote: "You stop breathing for just a few minutes and everyone jumps to conclusions."

events.summary: Ahmahz il Kin swears he is not lying.
events.quote: "By the tongues of a thousand serpents, this time I do not lie."

events.summary: Purraj sang slaughter and danced death.
events.quote: Purraj sang slaughter and danced death.

events.summary: Asmira leads Scalebane's elite to free Mangara.
events.quote: "With Rashida's blades, my guiding vision and the luck of the blessed, today we will free Mangara!"

events.summary: Asmira declares a war without neutrality.
events.quote: "This is a war without neutrality."

events.summary: Rashida Scalebane dons a dragon mask with no other options.
events.quote: "With no further options, I was forced to don the mask."

events.summary: Kasib ibn Naji sees a Phyrexian walker.
events.quote: But today I saw a walker—and now I fear the truth."

events.summary: Tuwile speaks of buried kings awaiting revolt of dead peasants.
events.quote: "Our buried kings silently await the revolt of dead peasants."

events.summary: Suleiman's ascension humbled djinn and efreets of Rabiah.
events.quote: With Suleiman's ascension to power, the djinn and efreets of ancient Rabiah learned humility.

events.summary: Sisay tells of a ring giving friends in other worlds.
events.quote: "With this ring, you have friends in worlds you've never heard of."

events.summary: Liefellen warns the land's privilege to be trod is ending.
events.quote: "The land has been gracious enough to let you tread upon her for years. That privilege is about to end."
